description: Live trial of collection selection (req-aws-collector-selection-5 and -14): the real Boto3Collector.run() three times against the GovCloud staging account (us-gov-west-1), with the collector's read-only identity and the read guard installed, writing to the local grid only. Counts, codes and booleans only; no account number, resource id or message.

checks.a restricted run states no completeness: all three runs: 0 surfaces, not declared
checks.rows of an unselected type are untouched: run 2 selected ec2:vpc only: the 14 subnets from run 1 are still live, same ids and same updated_at
checks.edges to an unselected type are not emit: run 3 selected ec2:subnet only: 14 edges not selected (one per subnet to its VPC), 0 EDGE_DROPPED warnings

not_covered: Retirement of a deleted object under a full run (the lifecycle negative control) and retire_within_selection (tap#1156) are not exercised here.
